home.aboutHeading: More than a ride — a connection
home.aboutBody: Cedars Trail Riding (CTR) is Lebanon's first eco-equestrian tourism experience. Our mission is to promote eco-tourism and help people reconnect with nature through meaningful horseback riding experiences. Every trail is studied to minimize environmental impact, foster a partnership with our horses, and support the local communities we ride through.

about.heading: Our story
about.body1: Cedars Trail Riding (CTR) is the first eco-equestrian tourism experience in Lebanon. Our mission is to promote eco-tourism and help people reconnect with nature through meaningful horseback riding experiences.
about.body2: Our rides help people reconnect with nature, support local life, and build confidence through a unique bond with horses — offering space to grow, reflect, and improve with every step on the trail.
about.whoBody: CTR is for everyone — families, solo travelers, couples, adventure seekers, locals, expats, and tourists. Anyone can ride our well-trained horses, whether you're a child or an adult, a beginner or a seasoned rider.
about.credential: Top 3 graduate, Batch 1 Phase 2, REAF program (per Berytech).
